invariant: CLI and process invocation preserve zero, one, many arguments and paths containing spaces
external cancellation is classified separately from build failure and cannot produce COMMITTED
required runtime modules are verified before execution
payload completeness is checked before activation

long operations expose machine-readable liveness and operation identity
retrying a completed operation does not duplicate publication or corrupt state
